Gather: Medical baseline, fitness, approved procedures, consent
Evaluate: Compare like-for-like values and identify unavailable baselines
Failure / authority boundary: No imported baseline means no personal-change claim

Evaluate: Show change, freshness, confidence and missingness
Act: Review approved next step or request assistance
Failure / authority boundary: No data is displayed as unavailable, never normal

Gather: Signal quality, device/connection state, event time
Evaluate: Separate missing signal from physiological abnormality
Failure / authority boundary: Do not carry stale values forward as live

Gather: Estimated sleep, duty schedule, diary and cognitive session
Evaluate: Review individual change and operational context

Gather: Specimen, method, analyte, units, reference range and baseline
Evaluate: Check quality and comparability before interpretation

Gather: Exercise load, adherence, fitness measure and baseline
Evaluate: Keep adherence and physiological outcome distinct
Act: Review countermeasure plan through responsible role
Failure / authority boundary: Missing assessment cannot be inferred from workout completion

Gather: Private report, relevant workload and sleep context
Failure / authority boundary: General crew view receives only approved operational constraints

Actors: Crew + ground medical support under current standard
Gather: Recent evaluation, fitness and mission task
Act: Record clearance or restriction from responsible authority
Failure / authority boundary: Future delayed-ground policy must be specified; app cannot invent clearance

Gather: Location, instrument, units, pressure, duration, relevant symptoms
Failure / authority boundary: Historical public archive cannot stand in for present exposure

Gather: Approved assessment, relevant observations and available resources
Evaluate: Present evidence and limitations to responsible person
Act: Follow onboard procedure and prepare ground packet
Failure / authority boundary: No free-form LLM treatment or autonomous prescription

Gather: Authorized packet, revisions, urgency and timestamps
Evaluate: Keep local saved, queued, delivered, acknowledged and reviewed distinct
Act: Retry transmission and continue onboard approved workflow
Failure / authority boundary: A queued message is never shown as medical review completed

Gather: Landing assessment, recovery tests and consented study data
Act: Review rehabilitation and permitted research release
Failure / authority boundary: Operational care records are not automatically public research data
